payload.acceptance_criteria:
When basicly install meets a basicly-gates.yml that runs tracker-commit-msg.py or verify --mode full without --ci, then it removes that line, adds --ci, keeps the previous copy as a backup and names what it migrated
When a workflow scaffold still reads tracker records after that migration, then install writes nothing to it, exits non-zero and names the path, the line and the manual fix
When basicly check runs and a file under .github/workflows reads tracker records, then it exits 1 and names each path, line and fix
payload.description:
## Context
When a consumer upgrades to 0.46.4, I want basicly to migrate the 0.46.3 basicly-gates.yml that still reads tracker records, so the consumer's CI keeps the owner rule of 2026-11-18 that CI never reads tracker records. Decided (a)+(b) with the Orchestrator on 2026-11-18: (a) _write_scaffold migrates an existing basicly-gates.yml, refusing by name when the shape is not exact; (b) basicly check runs ci_records.violations over .github/workflows and names the fix.
payload.requirements: Proof before the release: the lane build installed into a scratch copy of development, plus a control with the old lines, and a second install that changes nothing.
payload.title: Migrate consumer CI workflows that read tracker records and name them in basicly check
